facts.fact: As of 19 October 2026, the Bank of England lists Bank Rate at 3.75%, with the next MPC announcement scheduled for Thursday 5 November 2026, alongside the November Monetary Policy Report.
On 17 September 2026 the MPC voted 6–3 to keep Bank Rate at 3.75%; Megan Greene, Catherine L Mann and Huw Pill voted to raise it by 25 basis points to 4%.

The September 2026 summary said CPI inflation was 3.1% in August, was likely to rise further, and that upside risks to inflation were greater than at the July Monetary Policy Report, while second-round effects in prices and wages had so far been limited.

On 15 October 2026, Chief Economist Huw Pill, who has voted for a higher rate since April, said a future hike should not be read as the start of a long series of increases, and noted the Bank had held rates since the US–Iran war began in February.

polymarket-5167210.brief: The question asks whether Saudi Arabia's own armed forces carry out a qualifying air or surface-to-surface missile strike that impacts Yemen on 29 October 2026, Yemen Standard Time. A diplomatic pause or ceasefire before 29 October would lower the chance of a qualifying strike; continued daily operations would raise it.

Ballotpedia reported on 2026-10-14 that the independent caucuses with Republicans, that Democrats need a net gain of three districts for a majority and that Republicans can lose only two and keep control (https://news.ballotpedia.org/2026/10/14/republicans-cannot-lose-more-than-two-seats-to-keep-control-of-the-u-s-house-democrats-need-to-gain-three-for-a-majority/). Ballotpedia also reported that maps adopted or ordered in nine states since 2024 could, on 2024 presidential results, produce a net Republican gain of nine districts. Cook Political Report's 2026-10-16 ratings placed 185 races in Solid Democrat, 171 in Solid Republican and 21 as toss-ups, with the rest in Likely and Lean categories (https://www.cookpolitical.com/ratings/house-race-ratings). The American Presidency Project records seat changes for the president's party of -41 in 2018 and -9 in 2022, and the president's party lost House seats in 18 of 20 midterms from 1946 to 2022, gaining only in 1998 and 2002 (https://www.presidency.ucsb.edu/statistics/data/seats-congress-gainedlost-the-presidents-party-mid-term-elections). Gallup presidential approval was 35 and 33 percent in early and late August 2026. That series counts seat change, not how often the opposition took a majority. No votes have been cast, and results, recounts and runoffs are ahead. A shift in the 21 toss-ups, or larger effects from the new maps, would change the picture.

facts.fact: As of the Clerk's October 1, 2026 official list, the 119th House had 218 Republicans, 214 Democrats, 1 independent, and 2 vacancies (Florida 20 and Texas 23), for 435 voting seats.

The House Press Gallery lists the same 218-214-1 split and records the resignations of Republican Tony Gonzales of Texas on April 14, 2026, and Democrat Sheila Cherfilus-McCormick of Florida on April 21, 2026.

Federal law sets House elections for the Tuesday after the first Monday in November of even-numbered years, and CRS lists the next federal election as November 3, 2026, with the new Congress commencing January 3.

On October 14, 2026, Ballotpedia reported that the independent caucuses with Republicans and that Democrats need a net gain of three districts for a majority while Republicans can lose only two and still hold control.
Ballotpedia also reported that maps adopted or ordered in nine states between the 2024 and 2026 elections could, based on 2024 presidential results, produce a net Republican gain of nine districts.

Cook Political Report's October 16, 2026 ratings covered all 435 House races and placed 185 in Solid Democrat, 21 in Toss Up, and 171 in Solid Republican, with additional Likely and Lean categories on both sides.

The American Presidency Project records House seat changes for the president's party of -41 in the 2018 midterm under Trump and -9 in the 2022 midterm under Biden, and lists 220 House seats for Republicans to defend in 2026.
